checks.name: Three public briefing tones, three question topics and exit leave rewards, morality and progression unchanged
Only the final briefing confirmation unlocks the existing galactic map
Udina, Anderson and both councillors remain identified through all three first-audience responses; no Spectre verdict or reward is granted
Tali reveals the recording detail after explicit acceptance; public export contains exactly her recruitment without new resources or changed party
Reloading before the final handoff preserves the prior accepted Tali event and grants neither Spectre progression nor chapter rewards
Final Anderson confirmation grants only the existing Citadel reward once and returns the unchanged chosen squad to the Normandy
Actual save/reload preserves the single reward and unlocks the three investigation destinations after the handoff

limitations: The preceding Eden campaign and initial positions are explicit native fixtures, not played encounters or walked routes.
Position-only transfers derive from actual public exports and are imported through the public chooser. No DOM, style, clock, ATB, HP or application-state injection is used.
Tone replies are conversational variations only; no morality, relationship or new saved decision is invented.
Native tests separately cover all graph branches, optional Garrus/Wrex combinations, stale callbacks, foreign contexts and existing reward idempotence.
Dialogue text and staging are concise French adaptations. Full ME1 dialogue, voices, council portraits, original cinematics and fidelity 1:1 remain unverified.
This collector does not certify Electron, Windows, mobile, physical controllers or original ballistics.

provenance.relation: Identical fixture preparation, dialogue walkthrough, seven checks, eleven capture points and seven exports; additional production delivery metadata only.

productionMetadataAttempt.change: Remove only the final global networkidle wait; all functional steps and response-byte/dist assertions are retained.

resourceWarningPolicy: Only the same-origin GET /favicon.ico HTTP 404 and its exact Chromium 404 console message are warnings; every other HTTP, console or transport failure remains blocking.
